message.content: According to Tamara, if Cersei had embraced her family ties and relationships instead of treating them as pawns, she could have had a more balanced life and possibly created a more stable rule. This would have allowed her to achieve both power and meaningful connections without sacrificing her familial bonds. Tamara believes that finding that balance could have altered her character trajectory significantly and could have led to a different legacy for her. Specifically, she thinks that if Cersei had collaborated with her family rather than dominating them, she might have become a more nurturing and supportive ruler. This would have reflected a different approach to power and connection, showcasing how love and ambition can coexist without leading to isolation and destruction.
